_comment: 1.8 Village Friends. Six named villagers. loves/likes/dislikes are item ids ("fish" in likes = any fish). birthday = month/day. perk6 is the 6-heart reward. look = how they appear on the farm and in portraits (COSMETICS ids), scale = their size on the farm. Text: chat (tap lines on the farm), react (gift reactions), letters (sent at heart milestones, every week once best friends, the day after a birthday gift; {farmer} = the player's name), stories (4 and 8 hearts, shown as picture cards), weekly (the best-friend gift). Milestones and perks: src/systems/VillageRewards.ts.

friendship._comment: milestones: 2 letter, 4 story + keepsake, 6 perk, 8 story + portrait, 10 best friends (weekly gift)

villagers.name: Rosa
villagers.about: Warm and always busy. Her bakery smells of berries and fresh bread.
villagers.home: Lives above the bakery on Mill Lane.

perk6.text: Rosa's berry tart recipe for the Bakery

chat: Morning! The first loaves are cooling on the sill.
Flour on my nose again? Oh, never mind.
A pinch of sugar makes any day sweeter.
Your strawberries smell wonderful from the lane!
I'm trying a new crust. Wish me luck!
Busy, busy! But never too busy for a hello.
villagers.birthdayChat: It's my birthday! I baked my own cake, of course.

love: Oh! My very favourite! You know me too well.
Now that is a baker's treasure. Thank you!
I could hug you! Come here, you.
like: How lovely, this will go straight into a recipe.
Thank you, dear. That's very kind.
Ooh, I can bake something nice with this.
neutral: Well, isn't that thoughtful. Thank you.
I'll find a use for it, I'm sure!
How kind of you to think of me.
dislike: Oh. Well... it's the thought that counts.
Hmm, I'm not sure what to do with this one.
That's kind, but it's not really to my taste.
birthday: A birthday present? You remembered! Thank you!
Oh, you've made my birthday extra special.

hearts2.title: A little tip from the bakery
hearts2.body:
Dear {farmer},

Thank you for being such a good neighbour. Here is a baker's secret: start a long recipe before bed, and it will be warm and ready by breakfast. Your Bakery never sleeps!

With flour and hugs,
Rosa

perk.title: My berry tart recipe
perk.body:
Dear {farmer},

You have been such a dear friend that I want you to have my berry tart recipe. Strawberries, cream and a little wheat for the crust. You will find it in your Bakery now. Don't tell anyone else!

Your friend,
Rosa

best.title: Best friends!
best.body:
Dear {farmer},

I was thinking today how the whole valley feels warmer since you came. You are my best friend, and I mean it. Every week I will send you something from my oven. Here is the first!

Warmly,
Rosa

weekly.title: Fresh from my oven
weekly.body:
Dear {farmer},

I baked a little too much again, so this is for you. Enjoy it while it's warm!

Rosa

birthday.title: Thank you for my birthday gift
birthday.body:
Dear {farmer},

Thank you for remembering my birthday. I put my feet up for a whole hour, can you believe it? It was a lovely day, and you made it lovelier.

Warmly,
Rosa

cards.text: Rosa invites you into her bakery before sunrise. The ovens are already glowing.
"This was my grandmother's oven," she says, patting the old bricks. "She taught me to bake when I was smaller than Pip."
She hands you a lump of dough. "Go on, shape it however you like." Yours comes out a little lopsided.
"Perfect," Rosa laughs. "The lopsided ones taste best." She gives you her old bakery sign to remember the morning.
Rosa is in a flap. The village picnic is tomorrow and her big oven has gone cold.
Bram comes to fix it, Pip fetches kindling, and you bring fresh strawberries from your farm.
Together you bake the biggest berry pie the valley has ever seen. There is flour everywhere!
"I don't need a fancy oven," Rosa says. "I need friends like you." Juniper paints her holding the pie, and Rosa wants you to keep it.

villagers.name: Old Tom
villagers.about: Full of stories about the one that got away.
villagers.home: Lives in the blue cottage by the pond.

perk6.text: Two extra free casts at the pond every day

chat: Did I ever tell you about the one that got away? It was THIS big.
The pond's calm today. Good fishing weather.
Sixty years at sea, and I still can't whistle.
Dusk is when the shy fish come out. Remember that.
My knees say rain. My knees are usually wrong.
Pull up a crate and listen. Or don't, I'll talk anyway!
villagers.birthdayChat: Another year older, and the fish still outsmart me. It's my birthday!

love: Well, shiver me timbers! That's a proper treat.
Now you're speaking my language! Thank you, friend.
That takes me right back to the harbour. Lovely.
like: Ah, that's grand. Thank you kindly.
A fine gift for an old sailor.
That'll do nicely with a cup of tea.
neutral: Hm! Not what I'd catch, but thank you.
Well now, that's very kind of you.
I'll put it on my shelf of curious things.
dislike: Hmm. I might use it to wipe my boots.
Ah... I'm not one for that, I'm afraid.
Kind of you, but this old sailor will pass.
birthday: For my birthday? You've warmed an old heart.
Well I never! A birthday present! Thank you.

hearts2.title: Fishing secrets
hearts2.body:
Ahoy {farmer},

A tip from an old sailor: some fish only come out at night, and the shy ones like dusk. If the pond is quiet, try again when the sky turns orange.

Tight lines,
Old Tom

perk.title: Two more casts
perk.body:
Ahoy {farmer},

I've had a word with the pond. From now on you get two extra free casts every day. Don't ask me how, a sailor never tells.

Your friend,
Old Tom

best.title: My best mate
best.body:
Ahoy {farmer},

I've told a lot of stories in my time, but the best ones lately have you in them. You're my best friend in the valley. I'll send a little something from the harbour every week. Here's the first.

Old Tom

weekly.title: From the harbour
weekly.body:
Ahoy {farmer},

The fishing boats came in heavy this week. I saved you the best of it.

Old Tom

birthday.title: Thank you, friend
birthday.body:
Ahoy {farmer},

Thank you for the birthday gift. I spent the whole day telling everyone about it. Twice!

Old Tom

cards.text: Old Tom waves you over to the dock. "Sit down, I have a story for you."
"It was a stormy night, and something huge took my line. It pulled my little boat for a whole mile!"
"I held on until dawn. Then, splash! It let go, and all I saw was a flash of gold."
"I never caught it, but I kept my old anchor from that night. I'd like you to have it."
Tom has found a bottle in the reeds, with a faded note inside.
It is a note he wrote as a boy: "I hope whoever finds this has a good friend."
"Took sixty years to wash back to me," he chuckles. "And now I do."
He asks Juniper to paint him holding the bottle, and gives you the painting to keep.

villagers.name: Juniper
villagers.about: Quiet, kind, and always painting the valley.
villagers.home: Has a little studio in the old windmill.

perk6.text: Four new paint colours from Juniper for your decorations

chat: The light on your farm is lovely this time of day.
I'm mixing a new green. Field green, I think I'll call it.
Shh... I'm counting the colours in that cloud.
Everything is prettier when you slow down a little.
Your flowers would make a beautiful painting.
I painted your barn yesterday. Only on canvas!
villagers.birthdayChat: It's my birthday today. I'm painting the sky to celebrate.

love: Oh... it's perfect. I want to paint it.
You found something beautiful for me. Thank you.
This makes my heart feel full of colour.
like: That's lovely, it will brighten my studio.
Such a nice colour. Thank you!
neutral: Thank you. I'll find a quiet spot for it.
Hmm, what an interesting shape. Thank you.
dislike: Oh. That smell... thank you, though.
I don't think I'll paint this one.
That's kind, but it's not quite for me.
birthday: A birthday gift... you're so thoughtful.
This is my favourite birthday in years. Thank you.

hearts2.title: A painter's tip
hearts2.body:
Dear {farmer},

I have noticed how lovely your farm is becoming. Pretty decorations make visitors happy, and the more Charm your farm has, the faster your crops grow. Every little flower helps.

Softly,
Juniper

perk.title: New colours for you
perk.body:
Dear {farmer},

I mixed some special paints just for you: Mint, Coral, Honey and Midnight. You can use them on any decoration you can paint. I can't wait to see what you make.

Your friend,
Juniper

best.title: My best friend
best.body:
Dear {farmer},

I used to paint alone. Now I paint the things we see together. You are my best friend. Every week I will send you something I love. Here is the first.

Juniper

weekly.title: Something pretty
weekly.body:
Dear {farmer},

I saw this and thought of you.

Juniper

birthday.title: Thank you
birthday.body:
Dear {farmer},

Thank you for my birthday gift. I painted a little picture of it, so I will always remember.

Juniper

cards.text: Juniper sits by her easel, frowning at a painting of the valley. "Something is missing."
You walk with her up the hill above your farm as the sun comes up.
"Oh! It's the gold on the fields. Your fields!" She paints fast, humming happily.
She gives you her spare easel, with a little painting of your farm still on it.
Juniper is nervous. For the first time, she is showing her paintings in the village hall.
Everyone comes. Rosa brings tarts, Pip brings a frame made of shells, Bram fixes the wobbly stand.
The painting of your farm gets the biggest smiles of the night.
Afterwards she gives you her self-portrait. "So you remember who painted your farm first."

villagers.name: Pip
villagers.about: Collects shells, feathers and anything shiny.
villagers.home: Lives with their gran next to Hazel's shop.

perk6.text: A treasure from Pip every Monday

chat: I found a shiny rock! Wanna see? ...Oh, it's gone.
Did you know chickens can fly? Well, a little bit.
I'm a treasure hunter. Shhh, it's a secret!
Can I ride the tractor? Please? Pleeease?
I counted all your fields. Then I lost count.
Rosa gave me a cookie. Do you have a cookie?
villagers.birthdayChat: IT'S MY BIRTHDAY! I'm going to have SO much cake!

love: WOW! For me? This is the best day ever!
Yes yes yes! I love it!
I'm going to keep it forever and ever!
like: I like it! Can I have two?
neutral: Okay! I'll put it in my treasure box.
dislike: Eww! Do I have to eat it?
Um... can I give it to Bram?
birthday: A birthday present! You're the best!
This is the best birthday EVER!

hearts2.title: A secret tip
hearts2.body:
Dear {farmer},

Guess what! When you clear rocks and bushes on your farm, there is treasure hiding under them. I checked. Don't tell the grown-ups!

Your friend,
Pip

perk.title: TREASURE!
perk.body:
Dear {farmer},

You are my best treasure hunting buddy, so every Monday I will send you a treasure I found. Here is the first one! It was VERY hard to find.

Pip

best.title: BEST FRIENDS!!!
best.body:
Dear {farmer},

You are my best friend in the whole world. I drew you a picture but I spilled juice on it, so here is a present instead. I will send you one every week!

Pip

weekly.title: A present!
weekly.body:
Dear {farmer},

This is for you because you are my best friend. Every week!

Pip

birthday.title: THANK YOU
birthday.body:
Dear {farmer},

Thank you for my birthday present! I showed it to everyone. Even the chickens.

Pip

treasure.title: This week's treasure
treasure.body:
Dear {farmer},

I found this behind the mill! Finders keepers, and I'm giving it to you.

Pip

treasure.title: Treasure from the pond
treasure.body:
Dear {farmer},

I dug this up near the pond. It was a bit muddy but I cleaned it. Mostly.

Pip

treasure.title: A crow helped!
treasure.body:
Dear {farmer},

A crow showed me where this was. Crows are very clever.

Pip

treasure.title: Real treasure
treasure.body:
Dear {farmer},

Old Tom says this is a real treasure. I think so too! It's for you.

Pip

cards.text: Pip runs up, waving a crumpled paper. "A treasure map! I found it. Then I drew on it a bit."
You follow the map past the barn, around the pond, and three times round the old tree.
Under a big rock you find a tin full of shells, buttons and one very shiny marble.
"It's my treasure box," Pip whispers. "Now you need a treasure chest too!"
Pip's puppy has wandered off, and Pip is trying very hard to be brave.
You search the fields together, calling and whistling, until the sun is low.
A little bark from your hay pile! The puppy is fast asleep in the warm hay.
Pip gives you a portrait Juniper helped paint: Pip, the puppy and a very big smile.

villagers.name: Hazel
villagers.about: Knows everyone in the valley, and everyone's business.
villagers.home: Lives in the little flat above her shop.

perk6.text: 10% off everything in the travelling merchant's cart

chat: Have you heard? Rosa is trying a new crust. Very hush hush.
Shop's quiet today. Perfect time for a chat.
I know everyone in this valley. And everyone's business!
Prices are up at the market and down at the stall. Funny old world.
Bram says he doesn't like pie. Bram fibs.
A good shopkeeper knows what you need. You need a rest!
villagers.birthdayChat: It's my birthday! Don't tell anyone. Well, tell everyone.

love: Oh, you clever thing! How did you know?
Now this is quality. Thank you, dear.
I'll put this in the window for everyone to see!
like: Very nice. You have good taste.
Thank you! I can always use one of these.
How kind. I'll tell everyone you're a treasure.
neutral: Well! I'll find a shelf for it.
Thank you, dear. Every little helps.
Hmm, I might sell this. Only joking!
dislike: Oh. I have plenty of these already, dear.
Hmm. Not one of my favourites, I'm afraid.
Thank you... I'll pass it on to someone who'll love it.
birthday: A birthday gift! I'll tell the whole valley!
You remembered my birthday! Nobody ever remembers.

hearts2.title: Shop talk
hearts2.body:
Dear {farmer},

A little shop secret: the travelling merchant brings decorations at a big discount, and his stock changes every visit. Keep an eye out for that cart!

Hazel

perk.title: A friend's discount
perk.body:
Dear {farmer},

I had a word with the travelling merchant. He owes me a favour or three. From now on, you get 10% off everything in his cart. Friends look after friends.

Hazel

best.title: Best friends, officially
best.body:
Dear {farmer},

I know everyone in the valley, but you're the one I'm gladdest to know. Best friends! I'll send a little something from the shop every week. Here's the first.

Hazel

weekly.title: From the shop
weekly.body:
Dear {farmer},

This came in fresh at the shop and I put it aside for you. Don't tell the others.

Hazel

birthday.title: You remembered!
birthday.body:
Dear {farmer},

Thank you for my birthday present. I told everyone who came into the shop. That's a lot of people!

Hazel

cards.text: Hazel asks you to mind the shop while she fetches a delivery. "Just smile and weigh things!"
Pip wants exactly one sweet. Tom wants a very long chat. Rosa needs flour, quickly!
When Hazel comes back, everyone is happy and the till is right to the coin.
"A natural!" she beams, and gives you her grandmother's old shop scale.
Hazel knows every secret in the valley, but the village kept one from her: a party, just for her.
You helped plan it. Rosa baked, Juniper drew the banners and Bram built the tables.
For once, Hazel has nothing to say. Then she laughs and laughs.
She gives you a portrait of herself in her party hat. "So you never forget my face. Or my hat."

villagers.name: Bram
villagers.about: Gruff, but has a soft spot for pie.
villagers.home: Works at the forge by the old bridge.
chat: Hmph. Hello.
Your hoe needs sharpening. I can tell from here.
Hot iron, cool head. That's the trick.
...Is that pie I smell? No reason.
Strong fences, good farm. Yours are fine.
Work hard, rest well. Good farm, this.
villagers.birthdayChat: It's my birthday. Don't make a fuss. ...A small fuss is fine.

love: ...You brought me this? Thank you. Really.
Now this is worth a break from the forge.
like: That'll keep me going till supper.
neutral: Not sure what I'd do with it. Thanks, though.
I'll put it by the forge.
dislike: What am I meant to do with this?
birthday: Hmph. Nobody's done that in years. Thanks.

hearts2.title: Workshop advice
hearts2.body:
{farmer},

A word of advice. Upgrade your workshops. Each level adds a space in the queue, so they keep working while you sleep. Good tools, good work.

Bram

perk.title: Sharpened tools
perk.body:
{farmer},

I sharpened the tools in your workshops and oiled every hinge. They work faster now. Five per cent. I measured.

Bram

best.title: Friends
best.body:
{farmer},

Not good with words. You're my best friend. That's it.

...I'll send something every week. Here's the first.

Bram

weekly.title: For you
weekly.body:
{farmer},

Made too much. Or bought too much. Anyway, here.

Bram

birthday.title: Thanks
birthday.body:
{farmer},

Thanks for the birthday gift. I put it on the shelf over the forge, where I can see it.

Bram

cards.text: The village bell has cracked, and Bram has been at his forge all night.
He lets you work the bellows. "Steady. Steady. Good." Sparks fly like fireflies.
By morning a new bell rings out over the valley, clear and bright.
Bram looks at his old anvil, then at you. "Got a new one. You take this. You earned it."
You find Bram outside the bakery, staring at a pie in the window.
"Rosa's last pumpkin pie," he mutters. "Pip wants it too."
You buy it and cut it in three: one for Bram, one for Pip, one for you. Bram almost smiles. Almost.
Next day a portrait arrives: Bram, with pie crumbs in his beard. "Juniper made me. Keep it."
